metadata.title: U.S. Adults' Agreement on Allegations of Presidential Wrongdoing
metadata.description: Survey results showing varying levels of agreement among U.S. adults regarding allegations of wrongdoing against the President, with a focus on disagreement.
metadata.main_insight: A majority of surveyed U.S. adults believed President Trump abused his power, while smaller percentages believed he obstructed Congress or committed bribery.
